text:
Anya: Quick sync — Q2 hosted API prioritization: customer ask matrix, embeddings latency buckets, and rerank SLA. Need a decision by EOD.

Sam: Can we collapse the embeddings perf work into one spike? what's the engineering lift?

Miguel: Two levers from model side: quant + kv-cache improvements, and batcher tuning. Quant reduces cost but we need evals for quality.

Taylor: SRE flag: KV cache invalidation will spike memory usage during node churn. Need a rollout and mitigation plan.

Liz: Customer A (enterprise search) requires embeddings p50 < 50ms for small vectors. Customer B cares more about unit cost.

Anya: @Liz can you share qps and monthly volume estimates so we can map to Dedicated vs Hosted tiers?

Liz: Customer A ~2k qps peak. Customer B ~100 qps but ~10M vectors/mo.

Sam: For 2k qps, batching helps throughput but will hurt tail latency. Proposal: prioritized low-latency lane + bulk lane with larger batches.

Miguel: Agree. Suggest two model variants: `embed-fast-quant` for low-latency and `embed-precise` for batch/cheap.

Anya: Launch criteria (proposed): fast variant p50 <= 60ms on hosted, p99 <= 250ms, and cost <= 1.5x baseline.

Taylor: Ops guardrails: autoscale headroom, circuit-breaker to fallback to `embed-precise`, and require canary on 10% of regional traffic.

Sam: Rough timeline: 2 sprints prototyping (batcher + routing), 3 sprints perf & ops, 1 sprint canary & docs => ~6 sprints total. Feasible?

Elaine: From product matrix: Enterprise search = P0, consumer apps = P1, internal infra = P2. Recommend P0 for Q2.

Liz: Customers are okay with phased rollout as long as we keep them in the loop and provide clear fallbacks.

Anya: Decision: Proceed with two-variant approach. Q2 scope = implement low-latency variant + routing + canary + docs. Defer rerank SLA changes to Q3.

Sam: I'll draft the tech spec tomorrow. Blocker: need access to a dedicated GPU pool for perf runs and realistic traffic replay.

Taylor: I'll own the rollout playbook and fallout runbook (circuit-breaker playbooks + monitoring dashboards).

Miguel: I'll own quant evals and regression checks; will publish a quality report with similarity delta thresholds.

triage-bot: Reminder: add OKR link and update roadmap ticket `DEVX-4823` before EOD.

Anya: Thanks — follow-ups: @Sam spec, @Taylor playbook, @Miguel eval report by Tue EOD.

Sam: On it. :thumbsup:
